module: Flowgraph node 'Get Camera FOV' (repeat_instant category). Gives the camera's current field of view in degrees (core_camera.getFovDeg) on the output 'curFOV'.
notes: Side effect: merely reading the FOV forces the free camera (commands.setFreeCamera).

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (created by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

work.desc: Switches to the free camera if not already, then reads the FOV.
